verdict.rationale: Phaser's source is hosted on GitHub (phaser-gh-1, phaser-gh-2) and the runtime probe confirms it is MIT-licensed (phaser-probe-rt-1), meaning developers can freely read, fork, and modify the entire engine source when they hit a limitation. Community comments (e.g. phaser-comm-11, phaser-comm-12) even show developers digging into internals/rendering behavior, consistent with open-source access. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/tutorial on how to build from source or contribute patches, and no first-party statement framing this as a workaround path for hitting engine walls.
